operations.content: Hermes mcp add prompts read from the real TTY, so piped answers never reach URL-server auth questions; configure those servers with hermes config set instead, then verify with hermes mcp test. Repeated --env flags keep only the last value, so multi-key servers need one config set per key.

Hermes reuses Neocoder files instead of duplicating them: Tavily rotator launcher plus shared state at F:/CD/Opencode/.opencode, ddddocr server plus its browser_use venv python, Neocoder MCP config at F:/CD/Opencode/opencode.json with user-level cloudflare entry under C:/Users/user/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc.
